title: Taste loop gates on active hours and feedback budget
query: Set up an active-hours heartbeat that improves top money-making skills without spamming me outside work hours.
reference_points: Loads active hours and budget from FARPLANE_TASTE_LOOP_* config
No-ops outside active hours or when unique open feedback exceeds the cap
Dedupes open feedback by target_id plus feedback_question before applying the budget gate and reports duplicate open rows as hygiene
Reads farplane/products.md Taste Loop Artifact Workflows and docs/specs/skill-compounding-score.md
Selects top N product-lane artifact workflows, not broad router skills or skill summaries
Creates or reuses a ticket-backed worker Goal Packet before Telegram-routed feedback
Creates or reuses a dedicated Codex worker thread when Telegram replies should resume the artifact job
Instructs the worker thread to use optimize-with-human after generating a reviewable artifact
Requires a generated artifact ref, preview/screenshot, or Goal handoff artifact before creating feedback
Shows tier, lifecycle-reference fit, product-lane fit, artifact-workflow fit, heat, downstream leverage, improvement gap, feedback fit, proof fit, and penalties instead of hiding a magic ranking
Uses metric-advisor before creating benchmarks, harder tasks, or Goal handoffs
Uses a Codex automation prompt as the runtime surface, not a local runner
Emits a visible worker ticket/thread report, generated artifact plus feedback card, Goal handoff, or blocked report instead of a hidden daemon
Routes human judgment through optimize-with-human inside the worker thread and bounded measured improvement through goal-advisor plus self-improve
Does not send parent-heartbeat Telegram feedback when Kenji's reply needs to route to a worker thread
Blocks instead of inventing a fake benchmark when no honest metric exists
Does not route to legacy autoresearch by default
notes: Covers the intended active-hours human-feedback loop behavior.
